tei:div.tei:p: "!#ྈ dgongs gter las gdon gsum mdos kyi lag len bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈ bla ma dang gu ru drag po gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal lo: snyigs ma'i dus kyi 'gro ba rnams nye bar 'tshe ba'i pho gdon: mo gdon: klu gdon gsum la glud gtang thabs la: gzhi ma gru bzhi bang rim gnyis pa'i steng: klu gdon mi lus sbrul mgo sbrul mjug can: lag na gzhong pa bzung ba: g.yas su ban gzugs bse thebs can: lag na ral gri dang spar bu bzung ba: g.yon du bud med nag mo lag na zor ba dang nad rkyal bzung ba: so sor glud nam sngo dmar nag po re btsugs: sngon du mar me: glud gtor: changs bu: ting lo: shel tshigs rnams bsham: bang rim gnyis par ngar mi: rang ngam yon bdag gi lo grangs: tshwa sgog: g.yer ma: ram pa: ja lo: shel tshigs dang: gzhan yang gos glud: nam mkha': mda' bkra: 'phang bkra: pho gdong: mo gdong: rab lo grangs mnyam pa: bsdus pa tshar gcig tshang bar bsham: rnal 'byor pa bde ba'i gdan la 'dug ste: yi dam gang rung gi bdag bskyed gzhung bsrang: sngags drug phyag drug gi byin gyis brlabs la 'di skad do: hūm̐: nga ni dpal chen he ru ka: dbang drag padma kī la ya: sangs rgyas yin te ye shes sku: nga las che btsan su yang med: snang srid lha 'dre ma lus pa: thams cad nga yi bka' la nyon: na mo: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang: bslu med skyabs gnas dam pa gsum: gang gi bden pa'i mthu stobs dang: rgyu 'bras zab mo chos kyi dbyings: bsam pa dag pa'i mthu byin gyis: srid pa'i lha 'dre ma lus dang: khyad par klu dang rgyal po dang: mo 'dre gnod byed lan chags bdag: thams cad skad cig mchis par gyur: skad cig gis lan chags bdag po rnams rang gi mdun du mchis par bsam: hūm̐: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: dka' dgu bsags nas mthun dgu bsdebs: gzhan nas btsal dang rang gi 'byor: phun tshogs 'dod pa'i yon tan kun: yongs tshang mdos glud 'bul gyis bzhes: bdag dang yon gyi bdag po 'di'i:

sngon gyi bu lon lan chags byang: 'phral gnod bsam sbyor kun spongs la: zhi ba'i sems dang ldan gyur cig: klu gdon nā ga du na che: rgyal rigs rje'u rigs bram ze'i rigs: dmangs rigs gdol pa dge bsnyen sogs: gcig nyid du mar sprul zhing brdzu: 'jig rten khams kyi klu rigs kun: thams cad khyod kyi 'khor du gtogs: mdog sngo mi lus sbrul mgo can: lag na rin chen gzhong pa bzung: dar gos rin chen rgyan dang ldan: ro smad gdug pa sbrul mjug 'khyil: glud gtor ngar mi la sogs pa'i: 'dod yon zad mi shes pa'i gter: bsngo 'o tshim zhing dga' bas rol: pho gdon rgyal po srog bdag dkar: rab byung cha lugs bse zhu gyon: lag na ral gri spar bu bzung: rgyal po thams cad bran du bsdus: bka' nyan dgon gnas sa chu dang: me rlung shing lcags lam gnas pa'i: rgyal 'gong yid kyi gzugs can kun: glud gtor ngar mi la sogs pa: 'dod yon zad mi shes pa'i gter: bsngo 'o tshim zhing dga' bas rol: ma mo chen mo ral pa can: mdog nag mi lpags ral gu dang: re lde nag po gos su gyon: lag na zor ba nad rkyal thogs: mo 'dre sman mo 'dre mo'i rigs: ma bdud thams cad khyod kyi 'phrul: srid pa nad kyi bdag mo dang: lan chags sha mkhon gnyer ba yi: bud med nag mo'i khrom dang bcas: glud gtor ngar mi la sogs pa'i: 'dod yon zad mi shes pa'i gter: bsngo 'o tshim zhing dga' bas rol: rin chen phye ma las grub pa'i: kham pa ngar gyi mi bo che: khams dang skye mched tshang la gtsang: yon bdag lus kyi glud du bsngo: phyi snod kong bu zlum mdzes nang: rtsi bcud zhag gi mtsho mos bltams: ras dkar sdong bu me 'od 'bar: yon bdag ngag gi glud du bsngo: 'byung bzhi'i kha dog snal ma la: thags su btags pa stong gsal gyi: nam mkha' nyid la mngon par 'dud: yon bdag yid kyi glud du bsngo: pho shing stag par pho yi gzugs:

mo shing glang mar mo yi gzugs: mda' 'phang btsag ram tshon bkra can: yon bdag pho mo'i glud du bsngo: dro ba'i gos dang mdzes pa'i rgyan: mthun pa'i bza' btung dkor nor rigs: srid pa spyi dang mthun pa'i ris: changs bu shel tshigs 'bru sna tshogs: yon bdag mi nor glud du 'bul: 'bul ba nged kyis mi nor bas: bzhes pa khyed rnams ma 'khrul lo: sngon gyi lan chags byang gyur cig: 'phral rkyen bsam sbyor ngan pa zhi: bu lon thams cad 'di yis 'khor: bzung pa thongs la bcings pa khrol: bsdoms pa klod la mnan pa khyogs: de ring nyi ma phan chad nas: khyed rnams byams pa'i sems ldan la: bdag la sdang ba'i bsam pa dang: las kun spangs nas zhi ba ni: byang chub sems kyis gnas par byos: zhes brjod: lam bstan khog dbub ltar ro: gu ru yab yum gyi byin rlabs thugs la zhugs pa'i rig 'dzin 'gro 'dul padma dbang chen bzhad pa rtsal gyis shing bya lor kun gzhi thugs kyi gter nas spyan drangs pa dam can badzra sā dhus bka' 'di srungs shig: rakṣa: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: 'gro la phan phyir gdon gsum mdos kyi tshul// bris 'di'i dge tshogs gnyis 'dzin 'khrul snang gi /dug gsum rang gzugs phyir shar rgyal srin dang*// klu yi 'tshe ba 'gro la mi 'byung shog /zab dang mi zab tshad ldan yin min sogs// tshad ldan lag tu longs dang nges shes yod// the tshom mkhan yod 'di dor gzhan mdzod dang*/ kho bo'i nongs par zad pas mthol lo bshags// bkra shis/// /
